description: Create the Node.js proxy server (server.js), AI service module (src/services/ai.js), update vite.config.js proxy, create .env.example, and add .env to .gitignore. Independent of FEAT-001.
steps:
1. CREATE c:\Users\KING\number-academy\server.js using ONLY Node built-in modules: http, https, fs, path, url.
   - At startup, read c:\Users\KING\number-academy\.env (if it exists) and parse KEY=VALUE lines into process.env. Use fs.readFileSync with try/catch.
   - Listen on port 3001.
   - Handle POST /api/generate:
     a. Read request body as a Buffer via 'data'/'end' events, parse JSON.
     b. Validate that body.messages is present; if not, respond 400 JSON { error: 'messages required' }.
     c. Build the OpenRouter request body: { model: body.model || 'openai/gpt-4o-mini', messages: body.messages, stream: false }.
     d. Make an HTTPS POST to openrouter.ai/api/v1/chat/completions using Node's built-in https.request.
        Set headers: Content-Type: application/json, Authorization: Bearer <OPENROUTER_API_KEY>, HTTP-Referer: <SITE_URL || 'http://localhost:5173'>, X-Title: <SITE_NAME || 'Number Academy'>.
     e. If OPENROUTER_API_KEY is missing/empty, respond 503 JSON { error: 'OPENROUTER_API_KEY not configured' }.
     f. Pipe the upstream response status code and body straight back to the client (no buffering needed — just pipe res.pipe(clientRes)).
   - Handle GET /health: respond 200 JSON { status: 'ok' }.
   - All other routes: respond 404 JSON { error: 'not found' }.
   - Set CORS headers on all responses: Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, Access-Control-Allow-Methods: POST,GET,OPTIONS, Access-Control-Allow-Headers: Content-Type.
   - Handle OPTIONS preflight: respond 204.
   - On startup, print: `Number Academy AI proxy listening on http://localhost:3001`.

2. CREATE c:\Users\KING\number-academy\.env.example with exactly:
   OPENROUTER_API_KEY=your_key_here
   SITE_URL=http://localhost:5173
   SITE_NAME=Number Academy
3. MODIFY c:\Users\KING\number-academy\.gitignore — append `.env` on a new line at the bottom (only if not already present; check first).
acceptance_criteria: server.js exists and uses only built-in Node modules (no require('express'), no require('axios')).
vite.config.js has server.proxy['/api'] pointing to http://localhost:3001.
src/services/ai.js exports generateLessonPlan, generateActivities, generateAssessment, explainIndicator.
`npm run build` succeeds (ai.js imported by later FEATs must have no syntax errors).
verification: npm run build  (must complete without errors)
